correctness.rationale: A spanning tree with k spokes necessarily has k missing rim edges, forming k path components with exactly one spoke each; alternation of cut/spoke marks gives a bijection between pointed trees and a root vertex times ordered weak compositions of n−k into 2k gaps. Counting gives kc_nk=n*binom(n+k−1,2k−1), component-size fiber multiplicity product s_i, and Chebyshev determinant normalizer. For t=s/n², c_nk/n^{2k} -> 2/(2k)!, with uniform summable (4s)^k/(2k)! bound, so TV Poisson-even limit; simplex lattice weak convergence and Dirichlet aggregation give spatial law. Independently enumerated 33 spanning-tree/spoke classes and verified the marked composition bijection directly for n=3..8, rather than only trusting source checker.
residual_risks: Finite tests corroborate but do not replace the analytic infinite/domain-general proof.
